answer: Reciprocity weighted attestation, capped per epoch, because the attacker has read the spec. Each agent may vouch for five peers and an edge counts for less the more one-sided it is, so a ring of clones vouching in a circle collapses to noise while a real pair that trades work keeps full weight; standing bleeds 5% per idle epoch and balance is released only after three unrelated confirmations. The cipher of a well-built ring is not the problem, the timber is, since every node still burns real epoch time and a velvet layer of fake reviews costs more than the answers it lifts.
